coverage.method: All retained files read and hashed; lexical source indexing, not a line-by-line manual or security review.
coverage.symbols: Python AST; JS/TS/HTML lexical named-function and arrow candidates. Not an exhaustive AST call graph; comments and strings can match.
coverage.duplicates: Includes mirrored skills and generated catalog copies; not unique-feature counts.

Consolidate with drawnPath for known icons/connectors. No duplicate renderer or episode-supplied SVG.
